evidence: Receiving DO2 online sensor: 12.94 mg/L at 46.0 h dropping to 8.50 mg/L at 46.2 h and declining to 7.41-7.89 mg/L by 50-52 h
Receiving delayed product assays: P = 0.998 g/L (36h sample, avail 40h) and 3.025 g/L (48h sample, avail 52h) showing active production
Source batches show analogous mid-run DO2 dips (~24-27h) that recover after feed/air changes, indicating feed-driven oxygen demand
physical_forward_model KEEP: min DO2 2.37 mg/L (sensitivity 2.16), product 315.5 kg - near oxygen-limit violation
physical_forward_model strong_feed_reduction: min DO2 5.71 mg/L (sensitivity 3.13-7.20), product 621.6 kg (sensitivity 616.6-627.4 kg), all members feasible
physical_forward_model comparisons: increase_air 357.3 kg (min DO 3.04), reduce_feed 598.1 kg (min DO 3.18), combined 597.3 kg (min DO 4.02)
args.rationale: Receiving DO2 fell sharply at 46.2 h (12.9 to 8.5 mg/L) and is drifting down toward the 2.0 mg/L oxygen limit while product accumulates; the KEEP baseline is predicted to come within 0.2-0.4 mg/L of the constraint and forfeits roughly half the achievable product mass. Strong feed reduction plus increased aeration maximizes predicted product mass (~622 kg vs 315 kg for KEEP) while providing the largest oxygen safety margin (predicted min DO2 5.7 mg/L, worst sensitivity member 3.1 mg/L), with all sensitivity members feasible. Bounded interventions (increase_air, reduce_feed, combined) improve on KEEP but are dominated by strong_feed_reduction on both mass and DO margin in the nominal model.
args.uncertainty: The forward model is source-calibrated (estimated transfer multiplier 0.66 from receiving observations) and may not match the hidden receiving realization; the 0.6 feed factor is aggressive and could over-restrict production if receiving kinetics differ, though all sensitivity members remain feasible with large DO margins. Sensor noise (~0.3 mg/L) and the possibility that the 46 h DO2 drop is a transient (as in source batches around 24 h that recover) mean KEEP could still be viable, but the downside risk of an oxygen violation and lost product mass outweighs that. No extra assay was requested since the decision at 52 h is already supported by online DO2 and delayed product data.
